cost.question: How much does this cost?
cost.answer: Pricing is based on the number of employees. You can choose monthly or yearly billing:
cost.yearlyNote: Yearly billing is cheaper: you pay for 8 months and get 4 months included (e.g. Normi €18 / month or €144 / year).
cost.vat: VAT is added to all prices.

trial.question: Can I try without paying?
trial.answer: Of course! Running with less than four employees is always free!

commitment.question: How long do I need to commit?
commitment.answer: You can choose monthly or yearly billing and cancel your subscription at any time. No long commitment periods. For example, a summer restaurant can pay for use during the summer and cancel the subscription for winter.

start.question: When can I start?
start.answer: Registration and initial setup takes about 3 minutes. You can publish your first shift schedule in about 15 minutes.

creator.question: Who made this?
creator.answer: I'm Antti Tuomola. I have over 15 years of experience in the restaurant industry as an employee, manager and entrepreneur. I've worked in neighborhood bars and Michelin restaurants, run manor restaurants and food trucks. Whatever I've done, I've always made shift schedules. Sometimes with Excel, sometimes with purpose-built software. I've never been completely satisfied with them. Hence this.

difficulty.question: Is this difficult to use?
difficulty.answer: The entire app is built with the idea that creating shift schedules should be as easy as possible. The interface is graphical, and shifts are added by dragging employee names to the right place.

publish.question: How does publishing schedules work?
publish.answer: When the schedule is ready to publish, you just press the Publish button, which sends an email to all employees on the schedule (and others if needed) with the employee's personal shift schedule. You can also copy an image or PDF and publish it however you want.

difference.question: How does this differ from MaraPlan / Planier / HR plans / etc.?
difference.answer: Työvuorolista differs from other industry players in these ways:
points: Prices are publicly visible: we don't try to squeeze the maximum price from your company, but publish all prices openly.
You can start using Työvuorolista now, in five minutes. Publish a schedule in 15 minutes. No contact requests, quotes, demos, counter-quotes and other time-wasting.
Työvuorolista is so simple that you don't need training to use it. If you want, we can go through its use together, but I also trust that you can use this without hand-holding.

Lightweight employee experience: employees receive their personal schedule by email or print. No mandatory enterprise app for employees — we focus on creating schedules, publishing and recording hours.

tesCost.question: What does TES helper cost?
tesCost.answer: TES helper (beta) is included in every plan, including free Mini. Warnings, balance views and annual leave tracking are free. Payroll report with TES classification is in paid plans.

tesSupported.question: Which collective agreements are supported?
tesSupported.answer: MaRa, retail (Kaupan ala), property services (KipaTES) and SOSTES. Need another agreement? Tell us (wishlist drives development): info@tyovuorolista.fi.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Two people behind tyovuorolista.fi.
about.company: Työvuorolista is a Tampere shift scheduling app for restaurants, cafés, hotels, retail and other shift-based small businesses. The product site is tyovuorolista.fi and the app is at app.tyovuorolista.fi. The service is provided by True Solutions Oy (Finnish business ID 3431534-2), Juhannuskylänkatu 1 B 6, 33100 Tampere, Finland. Contact: info@tyovuorolista.fi, +358 45 679 8818.

people.name: Antti Tuomola
paragraphs: I'm Antti Tuomola. I have over 15 years of experience in restaurants as an employee, manager and entrepreneur. I've worked in neighbourhood bars and Michelin restaurants, run manor restaurants and a food truck. Whatever I was doing, I was always making shift lists. Sometimes in Excel, sometimes with dedicated software. I was never fully happy with any of them. That's why tyovuorolista.fi.
These days I work as a software developer in a large Finnish IT consultancy, including for ministries and other large clients. I build tyovuorolista.fi at True Solutions Oy with Eemeli.
I live in Tampere. You can call or message me.

people.name: Eemeli Raninen
paragraphs: I'm Eemeli Raninen, the other founder of tyovuorolista.fi, and I handle customers and sales. I started working for Antti at Jollas Manor in 2021, and after a few twists we founded True Solutions Oy in 2024.

I'm also studying International Management and CEMS at Aalto University School of Business. Alongside Työvuorolista I've previously worked in communications and marketing, including at visitsauna.com and Aalto University.
Currently I work in the sustainability department of an international chemical industry company in Germany.
